excerpts from Moehringer's "Tender Bar"

1. "Every regular at Steve's bar was fond of metaphors. One old bourbon drinker told me that a man's life is all a matter of mountains and caves--mountains we must climb, caves where we hide when we can't face our mountains."

2. incredible paragraph "Fear is going to be the great issue of your life...fear will be the fuel for all your success, and the root cause of all your failures, and the underlying dilemma in every story you tell yourself about yourself. And the only chance you'll have against fear? Follow it. Steer by it. Don't think of fear as the villain...think of fear as your guide, your pathfinder."

3. "Drinking is the only thing you don't get better at the more you do it."

4. for the Irish amongst you 💀
